The '''Maltorra system''' was a part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Maltorran]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="LostLegacy" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> and was also the origin point of the [[Maltorran protoplasm]].<ref name="Planetnamia" /><ref name="Xim">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek05/index.html|text=Xim Week: ''The Despotica'' (Part IV: ''Evocar'')|int=Xim Week: The Despotica}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Maltorra [[Star system/Legends|system]] was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square M-12.<ref name="EAOC" />
